Name: Dwarf Portrait Replacement
Author: LavenderSkelly
Description:
I've been working on a bigger Mod and needed to give Dwarf a makeover to make them Cuter and more Expressive for it.
I'm pretty happy with how they turned and wanted to share it as a Portrait mod as well an [u]Asset for fellow Modders to use[/u].

Based on: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1470?tab=posts]More Accurate Dwarf[/url] 

[u]Additional Dwarf Portraits Supported by this Mod[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?]SVE ( Stardew Valley Expanded )[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11666]Stoffton[/url]﻿[color=#f1f1f1] (Sprites also Supported to match Portraits)[/color]
[*][color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9642]The Last Smoluanu[/url]﻿ (Winter outfit Supported)[/color]
[*][color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30855]Dwarven Archaeologist[/url]﻿[/color]
[*][color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20414]They Deserve It Too[/url]﻿[/color]
[*][color=#f1f1f1][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30998?tab=files]Cut Characters[/url]﻿[/color]
[/list][i][b][u]Note STF Vendor [/u][/b][u][b]Portraits Must be [/b][b]Manually[/b][b] Overwritten for older than 1.6[/b][/u][/i]

[u]Other things to look at[/u]
[list]
[*][url=https://lemurkat.wordpress.com/2022/07/15/secrets-of-the-smoluanu/]Secrets of the Smoluanu[/url] (Dwarf lore)﻿﻿
[*][u]﻿[/u][url=https://www.kdau.com/dwarvish/]Stardew Dwarvish Translator[/url] (Really Useful for Modders)﻿
[/list]
